documents.unit: Center for Excellence in Teaching and Learning (CETL)
documents.title: Generative AI in Teaching and Learning
documents.quality_note: Teaching-center guidance: instructors set course and assignment expectations; names the governing policies (data classification, academic integrity, FERPA) and gives syllabus advice.

notes: The Division of Academic Affairs AI page (academicaffairs.uconn.edu/?p=856) is a hub of links with no rules, so not collected. The Senate policy on Academic, Scholarly, and Professional Integrity and Misconduct (2022) has no AI text. The Law School Academic Misconduct Policy has an AI rule but is not a computing unit, so not collected. No School of Computing or CSE department policy found (cse.engr.uconn.edu did not respond to curl). The known seed URLs were course syllabi, deferred.
